purpose: Typed identity required before formal M1/M2 training or gate production. Historical spent replay does not satisfy this contract by default. Controlled assets are invalid until environment alignment, raw-realization provenance and the pre-payload realization split are all bound and pass.
m1_hard_rules: the parent realization_id must be provenance-qualified by CSTAR_RAW_REALIZATION_PROVENANCE_AUDIT_V1 before any history from it is used
same-source nuisance pairs are grouped by house + geometry_identity + exact source_xyz_m, not source_id naming alone
same-source nuisance pairs use exactly equal source_xyz_m and differ in at least one declared nuisance intervention/realization
a pure transport pair requires equal release/sensor fingerprints and different transport fingerprints in the provenance audit
region/carrier identity never substitutes for exact-source identity when claiming exact-source invariance
formal sensor state is either audited_fopdt_internal_state under the frozen sensor model or the feature is explicitly absent; gas EMA may not be relabeled as FOPDT state
training/evaluation use causal prefixes or a preregistered bounded causal history window; final-episode-only history is insufficient for the formal online gate
uninformative histories are retained for uncertainty/abstention diagnostics rather than removed post hoc
m2_hard_rules: the parent raw realization must first be provenance-qualified; raw field availability alone is not a do(route) case
route geometry is frozen using truth-blind geometry only before any gas outcome is queried or extracted
retrospective subsequently executed adaptive path is not do(route) evidence
planned route coordinates use the geometry identity already passed by CSTAR_ENVIRONMENT_ALIGNMENT_AUDIT_V1
multiple distinct source_xyz_m values must appear in formal training/evaluation
held-out outcome realizations are not used to construct the route law
execution deviation between planned and realized route is reported rather than silently ignored
offline extraction from existing raw GADEN realizations is allowed only after route freeze and remains training/evaluation data; deployment remains bank-free
split_hard_rules: every declared split contains data before a formal gate is attempted
CSTAR_RAW_REALIZATION_SPLITS_V1 was frozen while the prerequisite inventory still had payload_read=false
all prefixes, histories, route cases and outcomes inherit the role of their parent realization in the frozen outer fold
no identical raw realization appears in both train and held-out evaluation
all prefixes/windows from the same house + geometry_identity + realization_id remain in exactly one split even when their file SHA values differ
leave-one-House-out evaluation uses the frozen H01/H02/H03 outer folds
confirmation data are not reused for model selection
